title: Partner representation audit for allelic heterogeneity
description: Frozen code and derived evidence for benchmarking partner-specific protein representations in human allelic heterogeneity. Version 1.1.0 is a metadata and documentation release with the six current manuscript authors and release stewards: Yu Zhang, Da Lin, Ying Chen, Yue Liu, Yi Zha and Wangqiang Feng. It preserves all scientific code, data, frozen specifications, statistics and figure source files from the preceding archive without reanalysis. The original v1.0.0 archive (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23161598) remains unchanged and retains its published creators Sisi Xu, Yu Zhang, Tiantian Zeng, Jiechen Liu and Ling Qiu. The current release metadata does not retroactively reattribute that archive. Preserved conclusions: NO_GO_EDGETIC_REPRESENTATION; PARTIAL_SEQUENCE_RESCUE; NO_GLOBAL_PARTNER_IDENTITY_SUPPORT. Pretrained weights, full encoder caches, third-party training sets and restricted raw database copies are excluded; obtain these from the original providers under their applicable licences.
